description: This file defines the TunerAdministrator class within the Thunder::Broadcast namespace. It manages tuner instances and observer notifications, acting as a singleton linking tuner implementations with external components. It includes mechanisms for registering, unregistering, announcing, revoking tuners, and propagating state changes, with internal synchronization.

classes.name: TunerAdministrator
classes.description: Singleton class managing tuner instances and observer notifications, providing registration, deregistration, announcement, revocation, and state change propagation functionalities.

classes.name: TunerAdministrator::ICallback
classes.description: Interface for callback objects to receive tuner state change notifications.

classes.name: TunerAdministrator::Sink
classes.description: Internal class implementing ICallback, forwarding state change notifications to the parent TunerAdministrator.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of TunerAdministrator.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers an observer for tuner notifications and notifies it of current tuners.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters an observer from tuner notifications.

methods.name: Announce
methods.description: Announces a new tuner, notifies observers, and returns a callback interface.

methods.name: Revoke
methods.description: Revokes a tuner, notifies observers, and removes it from the list.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Internal method to propagate a tuner state change to observers.
